metric.description: Geometric mean of two parts. Detection is precision/recall F1 over the set of variants, counted without abundance weighting. Abundance is abundance-weighted F1 over the per-sample counts. Variants are aligned by their nucleotide sequence, compared exactly and uppercased, because an amplicon sequence variant is defined by its exact sequence - two sequences differing by one nucleotide are distinct ASVs, not one spelled two ways, although ASVs do not correspond one to one with organisms or species. Samples are aligned by identifier, so column order is free.
